items.mainDefect: The async legacy writes in mode 3 build their timeout context from the request ctx, which is cancelled when the handler returns, so legacy writes get aborted and the legacy store drifts out of sync.

secondary.defect: Legacy write errors are never logged; they are only counted in metrics.

items.mainDefect: In Create, a Unified Storage failure is recorded with recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration.

secondary.defect: In Update, a Unified Storage failure is recorded with recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration.
The Delete success path passes the object name instead of options.Kind as the metric kind label, which creates unbounded label cardinality.
The DeleteCollection legacy goroutine records its latency with recordStorageDuration instead of recordLegacyDuration.
Delete puts the base d.Log into the context instead of the enriched log, so the contextual fields are lost.

items.mainDefect: In Update, a Unified Storage failure is recorded with recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration.

secondary.defect: The DeleteCollection legacy goroutine records its latency with recordStorageDuration instead of recordLegacyDuration.

items.mainDefect: Mode 3 legacy writes run asynchronously on a request-derived context, so they can be cancelled after the response is sent and legacy data silently diverges.

secondary.defect: The new Mode3 playlist integration tests read legacy data right after the k8s writes without waiting, so they are racy.

items.mainDefect: The mode 3 unit tests never wait for or assert the async legacy writes, so removing those writes would leave every test passing.

secondary.defect: The Delete and DeleteCollection test cases set up no legacy mock expectation, so the background goroutine makes an unexpected mock call that can panic or get lost depending on timing.

items.mainDefect: Mode 3 legacy writes run in a goroutine whose context comes from the request ctx, so they can be cancelled before they finish.

secondary.defect: Legacy write failures are not logged; only a metric is recorded.
